The parent requires consulting past applications, viewing general AUU information, and simulating expected monthly allowance amounts without submitting new applications. However, llg_001 only addresses viewing past applications, while llg_002 focuses on simulating allowance amounts. There is no documented capability for accessing general AUU information. Moreover, the simulation of allowance amounts should consider all relevant factors (e.g., ISEE, number of children) and not be limited to just inputting data.
